text:
Oliver (AM): @Maya + team — Meridiem (healthtech) reached out with a request to onboard a finetuned 13B multi-doc summarizer into Redwood Private. Key asks: PHI-safe processing, HSM-backed KMS, VPC-only control plane, and a performance target of p95 <= 150ms for ~512-token outputs. Target throughput ~30 qps. They also want a safety/hallucination regression eval before signing an annual renewal next quarter. Can CS coordinate eval + security checklist and flag any red flags?

Maya (CS): Thanks @Oliver — I can own this. @Raj can you assess infra feasibility? @Lina can you triage the PHI/HSM requirements? I’ll assemble an enablement plan and schedule the safety eval. Quick Q for client: are they expecting deployment only in us-west-2?

Raj (ML Eng): 13B finetuned is doable but 150ms p95 for 512 tokens is optimistic unless we use strong quantization + dedicated GPUs and careful KV caching. Options: 8-bit quant, dedicated A100/A10G pools, and pinned model versions. Need model artifact (hf tar or ONNX), tokenizer, and a sample inference trace to profile. Can we ask Meridiem for a small benchmark log and sample prompts?

Lina (Security): HSM + VPC private control plane is supported on Private. Requirements from our side: 1) dataflow diagram (how PHI enters, deid if any), 2) signed DPA, 3) retention policy (they asked for 1 year audit logs — confirm), and 4) sample prompt set for safety eval. Also: are they doing any client-side pre/post-processing? That affects our threat model.

Maya (CS): I'll request artifacts. @Dan can you provision a short-lived Dedicated eval slot for the perf tests? Timeline proposal: internal perf + safety eval in 10 business days, then customer-facing demo the following week. Is that realistic?

Dan (Support): I can reserve a dedicated pool for a 5-day eval window. Need to know preferred GPU type (A10G to be cost-efficient, A100 for headroom) and an estimated tokens/sec number. If they want <150ms p95 on 13B we may need A100 and quant.

Oliver (AM): Client prefers cost control, so lean A10G if acceptable. They're estimating ~30 qps average but more bursty during business hours. Renewal sentiment: currently "interested" — will likely tilt to "commit" if perf + safety checks pass.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Ask Meridiem for model artifact, tokenizer, sample prompts, and privacy/dataflow docs (due in 3 business days). 2) Raj to produce a perf feasibility note and config recommendations (3bd). 3) Lina to produce a compliance checklist and HSM onboarding steps (3bd). 4) Dan to provision eval env (5bd). I’ll create a shared working doc and schedule the kickoff.

Raj (ML Eng): To speed profiling, please have Meridiem run a local trace using this curl (sample):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.meridiem.example/eval -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"<concat of 5 clinical notes>","max_tokens":512}'
```
That gives us tokenization variance and avg token length.

Lina (Security): Also request any external integrations (EHR connectors, SFTP) and whether any PHI leaves their VPC. If they insist on no logs retained we need to discuss trade-offs with auditing.

OnboardBot: Intake ticket created: CS-2026-4893. Assigned to Maya (CS), Raj (ML Eng), Lina (Security), Dan (Support). ETA: initial eval workspace provisioned by 1767779999 (approx 2026-04-05).

Maya (CS): Thanks @OnboardBot. I'll ping Meridiem now and post the intake doc link here when I have it. Marking renewal-risk as "possible" until perf and safety checks complete.

Oliver (AM): I'll brief the customer on the timeline and ask them to send the artifact bundle + DPA.

Maya (CS): Quick note — if we see early perf shortfalls, fallback plan is to propose a distilled 7B variant or a quantized 13B with stricter batching policies. Will keep everyone posted.

Raj (ML Eng): ack, will map perf delta scenarios (A10G vs A100 vs quant) so sales has a clear recommendation.

Lina (Security): ack. I'll start the compliance checklist draft and post questions in the doc.

Dan (Support): Reserving A10G small pool for now; will switch to A100 on request. Sending provisioning ETA in the working doc.

Maya (CS): Great — closing loop. Next sync in #cs-standup and I'll add a short customer kickoff invite later today. :+1:
